name: Dark Ink Studio
description: Where shadows become art. Specializing in blackwork, dark realism, and occult-inspired tattoo design.

designs.title: The Raven's Eye
designs.description: A blackwork piece inspired by Nordic mythology. The all-seeing eye of Odin, wrapped in raven feathers.

designs.title: Bone Garden
designs.description: Floral skulls intertwined with thorned roses. A reminder that beauty grows from decay.

designs.title: Serpent's Embrace
designs.description: An ouroboros design with geometric dotwork patterns. The eternal cycle of creation and destruction.

designs.title: Shadow Forest
designs.description: A sleeve concept featuring dead trees silhouetted against a full moon. Blackwork with negative space highlights.

designs.title: Moth Sigil
designs.description: A death's-head moth in solid black, its veins cut back to bare skin. A night visitor for the chest or throat.

designs.title: Hollow Crown
designs.description: A black crown set over a dark sun with a hollow eye. Heavy blackwork for those who rule nothing at all.
